title: Server-side siteverify with the always-fail secret returns success false, the handler rejects 400, refusal body carries error-codes and no sitekey
asA: shelf consumer whose Worker fails safe on every Turnstile refusal
iWant: a POST to siteverify with the pinned always-fail secret to return success:false, the handler to reject with 400, and the refusal body to carry the documented error-codes value and never the sitekey
soThat: every failure branch produces a stable machine-observable outcome and never leaks the sitekey or the response token

acceptanceCriteria.description: A live POST to siteverify with secret=2x0000000000000000000000000000000AA (always-fail secret per https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/troubleshooting/testing/) returns success:false; the pack-fixture /api/submit handler rejects with 400 whose body carries the error-codes value (invalid-input-response) and no sitekey or secret substring.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture running with the pinned always-fail secret in the environment
acceptanceCriteria.when: a submit hits /api/submit with any response token and the verifier calls siteverify
acceptanceCriteria.then: siteverify returns success:false and the handler responds 400 with an error-codes body and no sitekey leak
